answer: Description: This Terraform program provisions an AWS-based CS autograder infrastructure using S3 and CodeBuild. It creates an S3 bucket to store autograder results, CodeBuild logs, and build artifacts. It provisions an IAM role and policy granting CodeBuild the permissions it needs to write results to S3 and publish logs to CloudWatch. A CodeBuild project is configured to pull student code from a GitHub repository, run tests in a controlled Linux build environment, and upload grading results back to S3.
